The Field arrival view reads its force layout instead of computing it (src/field-layout.js holds the one copy of the seed and the force constants, imported by the renderer and by the build tool): tools/build-field-layout.mjs runs the renderer's forces once, offline, over the same node and link model the explorer builds, so arrival costs no CPU and the geography is the same on every visit. The explorer page fetches the file, so the published site must carry it; it is derived from build/surface-graph.json and regenerates with the pages build.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: The exact positive path boundary for the Clifford Number 1.0 static reader artifact.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A promotion of repository-only intake, transport custody, staged POOF projections, private/local support material, or every retained research object.
interpretation_contract.new_paths_require: An explicit policy change, native release rerun, protected review, and a new artifact manifest.
